newsitem.title: USA: Med-Design Corp files 501(k) with FDA.
newsitem.headline: Med-Design Corp files 501(k) with FDA.

text.p: Med-Design Corp said Wednesday that it has filed a premarket notification 510(k) with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its SAFE STEP Blood Collection Needle.
According to Med-Design, its new Safety Blood Collection Needle eliminates the use of a vacuum tube to activate the safety feature, and it can be rendered safe anytime prior to the disposal process.
This unique safety feature allows the healthcare worker to draw blood without changing the technique or risking the introduction of air into the sample, the company said.
